name: PolyAndLineIntersection
comment: Intersection points of a closed polygon and a segment. vertices is an n by 2 array of (x, y) rows in order; the last vertex connects to the first. The segment is P(xp, yp) to Q(xq, yq). Returns the points sorted by x, then by y. A hit exactly at the first vertex of an edge is omitted, so a shared vertex is returned once. No intersection returns #N/A. Fewer than two columns returns #REF!. Non-numeric coordinates return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
